p: Blue House on the Stairs (계단 위 푸른집)

Gamcheon village was a Korean war refugee camp, and backwater outside of the city center. In 2008 it attracted the attention of local university students who began painting murals throughout the village as part of their social service…
Open all year, but most shops and galleries are open from 09:00 to 18:00
A village with colorful houses built in a stair-step fashion on the foothills of a coastal mountain. It is known for its narrow alleys, art installations, and panoramic views.
Sells tteok-bokki (spicy rice cakes) and eomuk (fish cakes). Provides a typical local street food experience.
Several small vendors and cafes offering quick meals and snacks such as ramyeon (instant noodles), kimbap (seaweed rice rolls), and beverages for sightseers.
Serves dwaeji gukbap (pork soup with rice), a staple Busan dish. Noted for its rich, clear pork broth.
Serves handmade kalguksu (knife-cut noodle soup). The broth is traditionally anchovy-based.
Serves tteokgalbi (grilled short rib patties), which are ground, seasoned, and grilled beef or pork. The meal typically includes rice and a set of traditional side dishes (banchan).
Serves sundae gukbap (blood sausage soup with rice). The soup contains Korean-style blood sausage (sundae) and various pork offal in a dense, rich broth. It is open at all hours.
A small, themed eatery within the cultural village serving grilled meat skewers and simple rice dishes. It is primarily geared toward tourists looking for a quick and casual meal while sightseeing.

Specializes in bindaetteok (mung bean pancakes), which are traditionally pan-fried until crispy. This dish is often paired with makgeolli (Korean rice wine) and is primarily open during evening hours.
A non-alcoholic cafe that offers coffee, tea, and juice. The main draw is the high vantage point providing panoramic views of the colorful Gamcheon village houses.
Serves traditional Korean teas such as sanga-cha (twin citrus tea) and sujeonggwa (cinnamon punch). This spot provides a quiet setting away from the commercial areas, suitable for daytime relaxation.
